author: TheEdgyUsername
body:
To all of the Senior Staff:

My plugin idea is a plugin which gives a map to the spectators which acts as a war map, it shows large groups of one team going towards one place, and makes it seem more organized than it is. My question is: How do I make this plugin a reality and does it sound like a good idea?

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
Well, a regular Minecraft map could possibly fulfill this purpose. However, the concept would need testing.

If you're trying to write your own server plugin (such as for Sponge or Bukkit), this isn't really the right place to ask.
